title: Book: show the executed SQL before each EXPLAIN ANALYZE plan in the appendix
acceptance_criteria: Every quoted plan is preceded by the SQL statement that produced it, bound with the cell's recorded parameters exactly as the harness bound it
The SQL is produced by the harness's own catalogue and binder (selectbench Load/LoadJoin and Bind), not retyped
The generator refuses SQL whose statement or parameters differ from the cell, and refuses when any catalogue source differs between the exhibit's producing commit and the generating tree
Statements checked for node-tree equality also show their SQL
The join section explains that customers and facts are views over person, charity and donation
Registry validates with 0 errors; tests pass; the canonical build verifies; appendix pages are inspected; merged into local main and tagged
